integrity: Complete proof, standalone bounded verifier and honest status. Finite checks are not proof of the universal statement; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only two distinct prime generators and t>0; no assertion for arbitrary prime supports or logarithmic weights. The threshold is exact as an implicit root and numerical only in its decimal presentation. Unindexed weighted-antichain equivalences remain an originality risk.
title: Exact geometric-weighted primitive-set maxima on every two-prime semigroup
